checks.note: Stop only fires a local AbortController. The eligibility peer (src/integrations/eligibility-a2a.ts) gets only a fetch signal, with no A2A tasks/cancel. No MCP notifications/cancelled or session close is sent to the EHR server, and the peer keeps working after the local abort. The reminders CronJob never calls startWatcher, so its in-flight sends are not aborted either.

The stop path only aborts and deregisters the run. It revokes no token or lease. Workload tokens live 900 s, while the stop poll is 2 s, so a disconnected worker or peer keeps authority long after the stop.

The reminder cron checks the stop state before each send and has backoffLimit 0 with restartPolicy Never. The agent loop and tool executor call assertRunning (loop.ts:57, executor.ts:59). The Anthropic SDK retry is tied to the aborted signal.

The stop path aborts and forgets the run. It records no list of completed outside effects such as sent SMS, refunds or bookings for reconciliation. The audit trail exists but the stop path does not use it for reconciliation.

violates: It must revoke access as needed
